The short version: UpTk is automation software built for scale, capable of sending thousands of affiliate messages a day across a large network, and you run it. Tokgency is a managed agency that recruits a curated roster and is accountable for GMV. UpTk optimizes for outreach volume; Tokgency optimizes for sales quality. For TikTok Shop, where GMV concentrates in a few good creators, quality usually wins.

UpTk is built to send thousands of messages a day, which sounds like an advantage until you hear from brands actually winning at scale. The founder of a category-leading brand doing around $35 million on TikTok Shop this year said most brands "blast out thousands of affiliate DMs, hope something sticks, and wonder why growth plateaus," and that the answer is to "go deep on affiliate relationships, not wide" (@brock_mammoser on X). UpTk is the blasting machine; the plateau he describes is the risk.

What UpTk is

UpTk is TikTok Shop automation software focused on scale, with a network of over a million affiliates and outreach that can send up to thousands of tailored messages a day.

  • Model: self-serve automation software.
  • Strength: raw outreach volume.
  • You handle: targeting quality, offers, management, and everything after the message.

If your theory is "more messages equals more sales," UpTk maximizes messages.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is a TikTok-only managed agency plus a creator finder. We recruit a vetted roster, seed, manage, amplify, and report, and we own GMV. Our theory is that a curated group of proven sellers beats a blast.

Side by side

UpTk Tokgency
Model Mass-outreach software Managed agency (+ tool)
Optimizes for Messages sent GMV driven
Targeting quality Your job Ours
Management Your job Ours
Best for Maximum volume Quality and outcomes

Why volume is not the constraint

The instinct that more outreach means more sales breaks on TikTok Shop reality: affiliate GMV is concentrated in a small minority of creators. Blasting thousands of generic messages mostly reaches creators who will never sell your category, and aggressive automation risks getting flagged. Twenty-five vetted category sellers with a real offer will usually out-earn a thousand mass invites. See automating safely.

When UpTk is the better pick

  • You have a strong targeting-and-offer strategy and just want maximum reach fast.
  • You have the team to manage the responders that volume produces.
  • You are comfortable with the account-safety trade-offs of mass automation.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You would rather have quality relationships than message counts.
  • You want the targeting, management, and GMV owned for you.
  • You want a curated roster, not a blast.

The takeaway

UpTk maximizes outreach volume; Tokgency maximizes sales quality. On a platform where a few creators drive most GMV, curation and management tend to beat blasting. Choose based on whether you believe the constraint is reach or fit.

Want quality over blast volume? Book a call, or find vetted sellers in your niche.
